name: GoHighLevel
description: GoHighLevel (HighLevel, LeadConnector) CRM for one sub-account: contacts with tags, notes and tasks, conversations and sending SMS, email or WhatsApp, opportunities and pipelines, calendars and appointments, users, custom fields, workflows, form and survey submissions, invoices, payments and Social Planner posts.
instructions:
## GoHighLevel
This connector uses the **HighLevel API v2** (`https://services.leadconnectorhq.com`, the platform also sold as GoHighLevel and LeadConnector) for one **sub-account** (location): contacts with notes, tasks and tags, conversations and sending SMS, email or WhatsApp, opportunities and pipelines, calendars and appointments, users, custom fields, workflows, form and survey submissions, invoices, payments and the Social Planner.

**Setup (5 minutes, sub-account admin)**
1. In the sub-account open **Settings**, **Private Integrations** and click **Create new Integration**. Name it (e.g. AnythingMCP) and select the scopes the tools need: `locations.readonly`, `locations/customFields.readonly`, `locations/tags.readonly`, `contacts.readonly`, `contacts.write`, `conversations.readonly`, `conversations/message.readonly`, `conversations/message.write`, `opportunities.readonly`, `opportunities.write`, `calendars.readonly`, `calendars/events.readonly`, `calendars/events.write`, `users.readonly`, `workflows.readonly`, `forms.readonly`, `surveys.readonly`, `invoices.readonly`, `invoices.write`, `payments/orders.readonly`, `payments/transactions.readonly`, `payments/subscriptions.readonly`, `socialplanner/account.readonly`, `socialplanner/post.readonly`, `socialplanner/post.write`. Leave out the write scopes the AI should not have.
2. Copy the token (it starts with `pit-`, shown once) into `GOHIGHLEVEL_API_TOKEN`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
3. Copy the **Location ID** from **Settings**, **Business Profile** (or the URL `.../location/<id>/...`) into `GOHIGHLEVEL_LOCATION_ID`. Every tool works in that sub-account.
4. Run `gohighlevel_get_location` to check both.

The connector sends the required `Version` header itself (2021-07-28, and 2021-04-15 for conversations and calendars).

**Workflow**
- Setup data: `gohighlevel_get_location`, `gohighlevel_list_custom_fields` (ids for `customFields`), `gohighlevel_list_tags`, `gohighlevel_list_users` and `gohighlevel_get_user` (ids for `assignedTo`), `gohighlevel_list_pipelines` (pipeline and stage ids), `gohighlevel_list_calendars`, `gohighlevel_list_workflows`.
- Contacts: find with `gohighlevel_search_contacts`, read with `gohighlevel_get_contact`; `gohighlevel_create_contact`, `gohighlevel_upsert_contact` (no duplicates by email or phone), `gohighlevel_update_contact`; tags with `gohighlevel_add_contact_tags` and `gohighlevel_remove_contact_tags`; notes with `gohighlevel_list_contact_notes` and `gohighlevel_create_contact_note`; tasks with `gohighlevel_list_contact_tasks`, `gohighlevel_create_contact_task`, `gohighlevel_update_contact_task`; `gohighlevel_list_contact_appointments`.
- Automations: `gohighlevel_add_contact_to_workflow` and `gohighlevel_remove_contact_from_workflow` (only published workflows), or add a tag that a workflow triggers on.
- Conversations: `gohighlevel_search_conversations` (by contact or unread), `gohighlevel_get_conversation`, `gohighlevel_list_messages`, and `gohighlevel_send_message` to send SMS, email, WhatsApp or social messages. Sending reaches the contact at once and may cost SMS or email credits: show the user the text and recipient and wait for a yes. Contacts with DND on a channel are not reached on it.
- Sales: `gohighlevel_search_opportunities`, `gohighlevel_get_opportunity`, `gohighlevel_create_opportunity`, `gohighlevel_update_opportunity` (move stage), `gohighlevel_update_opportunity_status` (won, lost).
- Booking: `gohighlevel_get_free_slots`, then `gohighlevel_create_appointment`; `gohighlevel_list_calendar_events`, `gohighlevel_get_appointment`, `gohighlevel_update_appointment` (reschedule, confirm, cancel, no-show).
- Leads from forms: `gohighlevel_list_forms`, `gohighlevel_list_form_submissions`, `gohighlevel_list_surveys`, `gohighlevel_list_survey_submissions`.
- Money: `gohighlevel_list_invoices`, `gohighlevel_get_invoice`, `gohighlevel_create_invoice`, `gohighlevel_send_invoice`; `gohighlevel_list_orders`, `gohighlevel_get_order`, `gohighlevel_list_transactions`, `gohighlevel_get_transaction`, `gohighlevel_list_subscriptions`.
- Social Planner: `gohighlevel_list_social_accounts`, `gohighlevel_list_social_posts`, `gohighlevel_create_social_post` (publishes at the scheduled time; confirm first).

**Reading the answers**: ids are 20-character strings. Dates on records are ISO 8601 in UTC; calendar free slots and events take Unix time in **milliseconds**; appointment start and end are ISO 8601 with an offset; opportunity search dates are mm-dd-yyyy; form, survey, invoice and payment filters take YYYY-MM-DD. Invoice and payment amounts are in currency units (120.5 = 120.50), not cents. Phone numbers are E.164.

**Paging**: contacts use `page` and `page_limit` (up to 500 per page, 10,000 results in total; beyond that pass `search_after` from the last contact). Opportunities use `page` and `limit` (up to 100) or `startAfter` and `startAfterId` from `meta`. Conversations use `limit` and `start_after_date`; messages `last_message_id` with `nextPage`. Invoices and payments use `limit` and `offset`; forms and surveys `page` and `limit`.

**Limits and errors**: HighLevel allows 100 requests per 10 seconds and 200,000 per day per sub-account (429 above that). 401 means a wrong or deleted token; 403 or "The token is not authorized for this scope" means the Private Integration lacks that scope (edit it and add the scope); 422 lists invalid fields; 400 "Version header was not found" should not happen through this connector.
prerequisites: A HighLevel sub-account with admin rights to create a Private Integration (Settings, Private Integrations) and its Location ID.

GOHIGHLEVEL_API_TOKEN.label: Private Integration token
GOHIGHLEVEL_API_TOKEN.help: Sub-account Settings, Private Integrations, Create new Integration: select the scopes, then copy the token (starts with pit-, shown once).
GOHIGHLEVEL_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces, quotes or a Bearer prefix.

GOHIGHLEVEL_LOCATION_ID.label: Location ID
GOHIGHLEVEL_LOCATION_ID.help: Sub-account Settings, Business Profile: the Location ID (also in the URL after /location/).
GOHIGHLEVEL_LOCATION_ID.patternMessage: The Location ID is a string of letters and digits, usually 20 characters.

verifyHints.401: HighLevel refused the token. Copy the Private Integration token again or create a new one under Settings, Private Integrations; check that it belongs to the sub-account in GOHIGHLEVEL_LOCATION_ID.
verifyHints.403: The token works but lacks a scope or the sub-account. Edit the Private Integration, add the scopes listed in the setup and save; check the Location ID.
verifyHints.429: HighLevel allows 100 requests per 10 seconds and 200,000 a day per sub-account. Wait and try again.

tools.name: gohighlevel_get_location
tools.description: Details of the configured sub-account (location): name, address, phone, email, website, timezone, business info and settings. Needs no ids; checks the token.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of the sub-account with id, name, fieldKey (contact.my_field), data type, picklist options and model (contact or opportunity). Ids are needed to set customFields.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_tags
tools.description: List the contact tags defined in the sub-account with id and name.

tools.name: gohighlevel_search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts of the sub-account by free text (name, email, phone, company) and/or filters, sorted and paged. Returns contacts with id, name, email, phone, tags, source, assignedTo and dates, plus total.

query.description: Free-text search over name, email, phone and company.

filters.description: Filters: [{"field": "tags", "operator": "contains", "value": ["vip"]}, {"field": "dateAdded", "operator": "range", "value": {"gte": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z", "lte": "2026-10-31T23:59:59Z"}}]. Operators: eq, not_eq, contains, not_contains, exists, not_exists, range. Fields such as firstNameLowerCase, lastNameLowerCase, email, phone, tags, assignedTo, dnd, dateAdded, dateUpdated, source, customFields.<id>. Wrap alternatives in {"group": "OR", "filters": [...]}.

page.description: Page, starting at 1 (page x pageLimit up to 10,000).

search_after.description: For deep paging beyond 10,000: the searchAfter value of the last contact of the previous page.

tools.name: gohighlevel_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id with name, email, phone, address, tags, source, DND settings, custom field values, assigned user, followers and dates.

tools.name: gohighlevel_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact in the sub-account with name, email, phone, address, tags, source, custom fields and assigned user. Fails on a duplicate email or phone when the sub-account forbids duplicates; use gohighlevel_upsert_contact then.

tags.description: Tags; on create and update they replace the contact's tags (use gohighlevel_add_contact_tags to add).

customFields.description: Custom field values: [{"id": "<field id>", "field_value": "..."}] with ids from gohighlevel_list_custom_fields.

dnd.description: Do not disturb on all channels.

dndSettings.description: Per channel DND: {"SMS": {"status": "active"}, "Email": {"status": "inactive"}}; channels Call, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, GMB, FB.

tools.name: gohighlevel_upsert_contact
tools.description: Create a contact or update the existing one with the same email or phone (following the sub-account's duplicate settings). Returns the contact and whether it is new.

tags.description: Tags; on create and update they replace the contact's tags (use gohighlevel_add_contact_tags to add).

customFields.description: Custom field values: [{"id": "<field id>", "field_value": "..."}] with ids from gohighlevel_list_custom_fields.

dnd.description: Do not disturb on all channels.

dndSettings.description: Per channel DND: {"SMS": {"status": "active"}, "Email": {"status": "inactive"}}; channels Call, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, GMB, FB.

tools.name: gohighlevel_update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact by id: name, email, phone, address, tags (replaces the list), DND, custom fields, source or assigned user. Only the fields passed change.

tags.description: Tags; on create and update they replace the contact's tags (use gohighlevel_add_contact_tags to add).

customFields.description: Custom field values: [{"id": "<field id>", "field_value": "..."}] with ids from gohighlevel_list_custom_fields.

dnd.description: Do not disturb on all channels.

dndSettings.description: Per channel DND: {"SMS": {"status": "active"}, "Email": {"status": "inactive"}}; channels Call, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, GMB, FB.

tools.name: gohighlevel_add_contact_tags
tools.description: Add tags to a contact without touching its other tags. Tags can start workflows that trigger on Contact Tag.

tools.name: gohighlevel_remove_contact_tags
tools.description: Remove the given tags from a contact; its other tags stay. Removing a tag can end tag-based automations.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_contact_notes
tools.description: List the notes on a contact with id, body, user and date added.

tools.name: gohighlevel_create_contact_note
tools.description: Add a note to a contact, e.g. a call summary. Optionally attribute it to a user.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_contact_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of a contact with id, title, body, due date, completed flag and assigned user.

tools.name: gohighlevel_create_contact_task
tools.description: Create a follow-up task on a contact with title, description, due date and assigned user.

tools.name: gohighlevel_update_contact_task
tools.description: Update a contact task: title, description, due date, assignee, or mark it completed.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_contact_appointments
tools.description: List the calendar appointments of a contact with id, calendar, title, status, start and end time.

tools.name: gohighlevel_add_contact_to_workflow
tools.description: Enroll a contact in a published workflow, now or from a given start time. The workflow then runs its actions (messages, waits, updates) for that contact.

eventStartTime.description: Start time for date-based workflows, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-01T10:00:00+01:00.

tools.name: gohighlevel_remove_contact_from_workflow
tools.description: Remove a contact from a workflow so its remaining steps do not run for that contact.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_workflows
tools.description: List the workflows of the sub-account with id, name, status (draft or published) and dates. Only published workflows accept contacts.

tools.name: gohighlevel_search_conversations
tools.description: Search conversations (one thread per contact across SMS, email, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, chat) by contact, text, assignee, status or last message type. Returns id, contact, last message and unread count.

status.description: all, read, unread, starred or recents.

last_message_type.description: Only conversations whose last message is of this type, e.g. TYPE_SMS, TYPE_EMAIL, TYPE_WHATSAPP, TYPE_CALL.

start_after_date.description: Paging: the sort value (timestamp in ms) of the last conversation of the previous page.

tools.name: gohighlevel_get_conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation by id: contact, channel, assigned user, unread count, starred flag and last message.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_messages
tools.description: List the messages of a conversation, newest first: direction (inbound or outbound), type, body, status, attachments and date. Page with last_message_id.

last_message_id.description: Paging: lastMessageId from the previous page.

type.description: Only these message types, comma-separated, e.g. TYPE_SMS,TYPE_EMAIL.

tools.name: gohighlevel_send_message
tools.description: Send an SMS, email, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook or live chat message to a contact through the sub-account, now or scheduled. Email needs subject and html or message; SMS uses message.

message.description: Text of the message (SMS, WhatsApp, chat) or plain text of an email.

emailFrom.description: Sender address for email, e.g. "Anna <anna@example.com>"; default the sub-account's sender.

emailTo.description: Send the email to this address instead of the contact's main email.

fromNumber.description: Sender phone number for SMS, E.164.

toNumber.description: Recipient number if different from the contact's phone, E.164.

replyMessageId.description: Message id this replies to (email threads).

scheduledTimestamp.description: Send later: UTC Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the opportunity pipelines of the sub-account with their stages (id, name, position). Pipeline and stage ids are needed to create or move opportunities.

tools.name: gohighlevel_search_opportunities
tools.description: Search opportunities (deals) by text, pipeline, stage, status, contact, assignee or date. Returns name, monetary value, status, stage, contact and dates with meta.total.

q.description: Search text (name, contact email or phone).

status.description: open, won, lost, abandoned or all.

endDate.description: Created up to this date, mm-dd-yyyy.

startAfter.description: Cursor paging: meta.startAfter of the previous page.

startAfterId.description: Cursor paging: meta.startAfterId of the previous page.

tools.name: gohighlevel_get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one opportunity by id: name, pipeline and stage, status, monetary value, contact, assigned user, custom fields and dates.

tools.name: gohighlevel_create_opportunity
tools.description: Create an opportunity (deal) for a contact in a pipeline stage with name, status, value, assignee and custom fields.

monetaryValue.description: Deal value in the sub-account currency.

tools.name: gohighlevel_update_opportunity
tools.description: Update an opportunity: move it to another stage or pipeline, rename, change value, status, assignee or custom fields. Only the fields passed change.

monetaryValue.description: Deal value in the sub-account currency.

tools.name: gohighlevel_update_opportunity_status
tools.description: Set only the status of an opportunity: open, won, lost (optionally with a lost reason) or abandoned.

lostReasonId.description: Lost reason id when status is lost.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_calendars
tools.description: List the calendars of the sub-account with id, name, type, team members, slot duration and widget settings.

tools.name: gohighlevel_get_free_slots
tools.description: Free booking slots of a calendar between two dates (at most 31 days apart), grouped by day, in the requested time zone. Use before gohighlevel_create_appointment.

startDate.description: Start as Unix time in milliseconds.

endDate.description: End as Unix time in milliseconds (at most 31 days after start).

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the slots, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

userId.description: Only slots of this team member.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_calendar_events
tools.description: List appointments and events between two times for a calendar, a user or a calendar group (one of the three is required), with contact, status, start and end.

startTime.description: Start as Unix time in milliseconds.

endTime.description: End as Unix time in milliseconds.

tools.name: gohighlevel_get_appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment by id: calendar, contact, assigned user, title, status, address or meeting link, start and end time.

tools.name: gohighlevel_create_appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment for a contact in a calendar at a start time, with status, assigned user, location and notes. Check gohighlevel_get_free_slots first.

endTime.description: End, ISO 8601 with offset; default start plus the calendar slot duration.

appointmentStatus.description: new, confirmed, cancelled, showed, noshow or invalid.

meetingLocationType.description: custom, zoom, gmeet, phone, address, ms_teams or google.

ignoreFreeSlotValidation.description: Book even if the slot is not free (default false).

toNotify.description: Send the calendar notifications and run its workflows (default true).

tools.name: gohighlevel_update_appointment
tools.description: Update an appointment: reschedule, change status (confirmed, cancelled, showed, noshow), assignee, title, location or notes. Only the fields passed change.

endTime.description: End, ISO 8601 with offset; default start plus the calendar slot duration.

appointmentStatus.description: new, confirmed, cancelled, showed, noshow or invalid.

meetingLocationType.description: custom, zoom, gmeet, phone, address, ms_teams or google.

ignoreFreeSlotValidation.description: Book even if the slot is not free (default false).

toNotify.description: Send the calendar notifications and run its workflows (default true).

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_users
tools.description: List the users (team members) of the sub-account with id, name, email, phone, role and permissions. User ids are used for assignedTo fields.

tools.name: gohighlevel_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by id: name, email, phone, role, type, permissions and the sub-accounts it can access.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_forms
tools.description: List the forms of the sub-account with id and name; form ids filter gohighlevel_list_form_submissions.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_form_submissions
tools.description: List form submissions with contact id, name, email, the submitted fields and date. Filter by form, contact or date range (default the last month).

q.description: Search by contact id, name, email or phone.

startAt.description: From this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default one month ago).

endAt.description: Up to this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_surveys
tools.description: List the surveys of the sub-account with id and name; survey ids filter gohighlevel_list_survey_submissions.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_survey_submissions
tools.description: List survey submissions with contact, answers and date. Filter by survey, contact or date range (default the last month).

q.description: Search by contact id, name, email or phone.

startAt.description: From this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default one month ago).

endAt.description: Up to this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices of the sub-account with number, name, contact, status (draft, sent, paid, void, partially_paid, ...), total, amount due, currency, issue and due date.

status.description: Only this status, e.g. sent, paid, draft, void.

search.description: Search by invoice id, name, email or phone.

endAt.description: Issued up to this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

sortOrder.description: ascend or descend by issue date.

tools.name: gohighlevel_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id: number, contact and business details, line items, discount, taxes, totals, amount paid and due, status, dates and payment link details.

tools.name: gohighlevel_create_invoice
tools.description: Create a draft invoice for a contact with line items, currency, issue and due date, business details, discount and terms. Send it with gohighlevel_send_invoice.

title.description: Title printed on the invoice, e.g. INVOICE.

currency.description: Currency code, e.g. USD or EUR.

items.description: Line items: [{"name": "Consulting", "description": "October", "currency": "EUR", "amount": 120, "qty": 5}] (amount per unit in currency units).

termsNotes.description: Terms and notes printed on the invoice (HTML allowed).

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number; default the next number from the sub-account settings.

liveMode.description: true for live payments, false for test mode.

tools.name: gohighlevel_send_invoice
tools.description: Send an invoice to the contact by email, SMS, both, or mark it as sent manually. The contact receives a payment link; confirm with the user first.

userId.description: User id sending the invoice (from gohighlevel_list_users).

liveMode.description: true for live payments, false for test mode.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_orders
tools.description: List payment orders (funnel, store and payment link sales) with contact, amount, currency, status, payment status and date. Filter by status, contact, date or search.

tools.name: gohighlevel_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id: contact, line items with products and prices, amount, currency, status, payment status, source and fulfillment.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions (charges and refunds) with contact, amount, currency, status, payment provider, source (funnel, invoice, store) and date.

entityId.description: Only transactions of this entity (e.g. invoice id).

entitySourceType.description: Source, e.g. funnel, invoice or store.

tools.name: gohighlevel_get_transaction
tools.description: Get one payment transaction by id: amount, currency, status, contact, provider charge id, source entity and refund state.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring payment subscriptions with contact, product, amount, interval, status and dates.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_social_accounts
tools.description: List the social media accounts connected to the Social Planner (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Google Business, TikTok, X, ...) with their account ids for posting.

tools.name: gohighlevel_list_social_posts
tools.description: List Social Planner posts in a date range: content, accounts, media, status (scheduled, published, draft, failed) and schedule date.

type.description: all (default), recent, scheduled, draft, failed, in_review, published, in_progress or deleted.

skip.description: Posts to skip, as a string.

limit.description: Posts per page, as a string.

tools.name: gohighlevel_create_social_post
tools.description: Create a Social Planner post for one or more connected accounts: text, media, as draft or scheduled for a date. Publishes publicly at the scheduled time; confirm with the user.

summary.description: Post text (trimmed to each platform's limit).

followUpComment.description: First comment to add after publishing (not on TikTok and Google Business).
